summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience driving Digital Transformation by building high-performance mobile, web, and desktop applications using Flutter, React, and WPF (C#). Proven expertise in implementing MVVM architecture for enterprise-grade ERP systems, Fintech solutions, Point-of-Sale (POS), and Smart Retail automation across the GCC region.

Expert in integrating AI/ML capabilities, computer vision (YOLO), and LLMs (OpenAI, LangChain) into user-centric applications. Proficient in Cloud-Native development (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure), DevOps automation, and IoT edge computing. Strong background in network security and secure architecture for scalable business solutions.

experience.description: Architected and deployed IdolMEA ERP system driving digital transformation for 50+ retail branches across the GCC. Developed IdolQueue (i-QMS) using Flutter and Node.js. Implemented AI-powered chatbot automation and YOLO object detection.
Led development of SincA ERP platform (Flutter + Node.js + Python AI backend). Implemented AI-powered dashboards and predictive analytics. Developed OCR invoice parsing system with 95% accuracy.
Developed comprehensive ERP, accounting, and billing systems using WPF (C#) with MVVM architecture. Built admin portals and reporting dashboards.
